description: Search official UK insolvency notices in The Gazette — the statutory public record where liquidations, administrations, winding-up petitions and orders, bankruptcy orders, creditors' meetings, and notices to creditors MUST be published. The go-to source for "is UK company X in liquidation/administration", monitoring company distress, or tracking personal bankruptcies. Search by company name or Companies House number (both are indexed). scope narrows to "corporate" or "personal" insolvency. Example: gazette_insolvency_notices({ company: "Wilko", scope: "corporate" })

company.description: Company name, Companies House number, or person name to search

notice_types.description: Advanced: 4-digit notice type codes joined with "+", e.g. "2450" petitions to wind up

name: gazette_insolvency_notices
title: Gazette Insolvency Notices
